newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 20.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Tuesday:
* A Harvard University study of 32,000 healthy women that took place over 10 years has found that second-hand smoke doubles one's risk of heart disease.

* The former Zaire, now known as Congo in the wake of a military defeat of a dictatorship led by Mobutu Sese Seko, looks forward to a new phase, forcing those left behind to look back at the past three decades.
* President Clinton is pushing for Congressional renewal of normal trading status for China.
* New York Gov. George Pataki is facing criticism for his welfare plan from several local social service commissioners, who oversee the state's programs for the poor.
* The Pentagon, in a blueprint for the 21st century, is seeking a new round of base closings, reductions in the number of active-duty troops and cuts in the planned fleet of new jet fighters.
* The death of fashion photographer Davide Sorrenti is stripping away the veil of secrecy and denial in the fashion industry of heroin abuse.
* A small-time New York City stockbroker is accused of killing a police officer during a bungled burglary of his father's penthouse apartment.
